module: Flowgraph node "Raycast" (repeat_instant, tags util/draw). Casts a ray from pos in direction dir and hits the first static collision object (TSStatic, terrain) via castRayStatic. Inputs: pos, dir (vec3), dist (hidden, 1000 by default; otherwise the length of dir). Outputs: hit/miss (flow), pos (impact point) and dist (distance traveled). data.debug draws spheres, line and text.
notes: If there is no impact, castRayStatic returns a distance >= dist and pos is then the end of the ray.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Calls castRayStatic(pos, dir, dist), computes the impact point and writes hit, miss, pos and dist.
